brand.name: Smell Panties
brand.bio: A premium direct-to-fan platform for certified unique digital and physical creator products, private access, live experiences and creator-owned audiences.
brand.founder_claim: 9% flat platform fee per transaction, including payment processing, locked for life for the first 1,000 creators while their subscription remains continuously renewed.
brand.custom_domain_claim: Creators can operate on their own domain and retain ownership of their subscriber base for one flat yearly domain fee.

platform_token.name: SP-Nudes
platform_token.rule: Fans spend SP-Nudes on creator profiles. Every SP-Nude spent mints one unit of that creator’s token in the MVP demo wallet.
platform_token.disclaimer: MVP utility economy only: non-transferable, not an investment asset, no cash-market pricing.

brand.creator_token_rule: Each creator chooses a unique token name during onboarding. One creator token represents one eligible nude-photo redemption/drop in the MVP economy.
brand.leaderboard_rule: Top 9 creator tokens are ranked by cumulative SP-Nudes spent on that creator profile.
